description: Presidential Secretariat - Functions and Duties amended further with effect from 17.06.2021
categorisation: This gazette contains both the naming of a specific individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities, including lists of departments, statutory institutions, public corporations, and specific laws/ordinances assigned to the Minister of Industries and Minister of Agriculture. This combination of "who" (the President making the assignment) and "what" (detailed institutional and legal framework responsibilities) meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
